about_the_game:
Embark on a quest to free your Village from a the CURSE OF THE FOREST

When an Evil Shaman cursed Albadusk Village and its surroundings with Dark Magic, the surrounding Forest grew in a disproportional manner trapping everyone inside.
Now your mission is to break the curse!

Beware the Nahuals!

Nahuals are Human-Animal hybrid creatures, cursed by The Shaman. Being good at combat will be essential for survival.

Explore and solve Puzzles!

Items and tools are required to solve puzzles. But are found in different sections of the game.

Albadusk Village is a HUB where you are able to access different areas dedicated to a different God. The Eternal, The Nocturnal and Alba the Crossbreed.

Features

  • Exploration


    From Albadusk you can access three different regions to explore. Each containing challenges, puzzles, enemies and odd characters.

  • Mixture of Gimmick and Combat Bosses 


    Not every boss is the same. On every encounter you need to figure how to approach.

  • Puzzle Dungeons 


    The only way forward in any dungeon is through wit, attention to detail, and reasoning. 

  • Uncover deep lore
    Learn the legend of Velcira the first Priestess, the Eternal gods, and the mystery of the Shaman. 

  • Atmosphere 


    Inspired by Zelda and Castlevania, with the soul of a survival horror
    Dungeon design, free exploration, and a constant sense of danger and discovery.

  • A Dark religious aesthetics
    Culturally inspired on Mexican Culture and Catholicism featuring Gothic and Baroque art-style, and a liturgical nightmare ambiance all flavored with inspirations
